summary: Ceragon Networks filed a Form 6-K furnishing a press release announcing a commercial collaboration with RADWIN to resell RADWIN's sub-6 GHz wireless access products alongside its microwave and millimeter-wave portfolio. No stake, purchase price, premium, board recommendation, advisor, or closing date is disclosed; this is a product/portfolio partnership, not a special situation. Ceragon acts as global solution provider, adding a specialized sales team and a multi-vendor management roadmap. Watch for revenue contribution and margin mix from the new access line, but there is no deal terms or arbitrage angle.
